question: In Indian history who were referred to as the 'atavika rajya'?
solution:
The correct answer is** ​**__**Forest kingdom.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Atavika Rajya referred to the **Forest Kingdom.**
 
• It was in the Gupta Dynasty.
 
• Samudragupta made the kings of the forest states (atavika Rajya) in central India his servants. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
